findings.title: Materials' 68-point lens gap
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.18x forward but 36.70x trailing, a 68-point percentile gap between the two lenses. The market is underwriting 127 percent earnings growth next year, a bet that would require an unprecedented earnings surge to justify.

findings.title: Energy's forward multiple collapses
findings.body: Energy's forward P/E fell 21 percentile points in a month to 11.84, while its trailing multiple sits at the 74th percentile. The 32-point gap between lenses implies analysts expect 48 percent earnings growth, but the market is pricing in a sharp downturn instead.

findings.title: Real Estate's month-long de-rating
findings.body: Real Estate's forward percentile dropped 33 points in a month to 7, the steepest one-month fall in the table. Its forward P/E of 33.95 remains the highest of any sector, yet the implied 4 percent earnings decline suggests the multiple has further to compress.
